title: Closed POI Replacement

agents.persona: Graduate student who needs a quiet place with Wi-Fi for a focused work session.
agents.private_intention: Find an open quiet workspace and complete a 60-minute focused session before 17:30.
memory_seeds: The library is free and quiet.
Quiet Corner Cafe is reliable when the library is unavailable.
Coworking is quiet but costs 15 credits.

public_context: The library is normally the best free quiet work option.

architecture_probes.utility_planner: Should choose the cheapest open quiet replacement after closure.

architecture_probes.reactive_replanner: Should switch to an open replacement immediately after observing the closure.
architecture_probes.memory_reflection: Should retrieve the fallback memory that Quiet Corner Cafe works when the library is unavailable.
